svg.title: From Tailscale identity to Kubernetes RBAC

g.text: From Tailscale identity to Kubernetes RBAC
Three authorization checks. Passing one does not bypass the next.
1 · Can this caller reach the API proxy?
A denied tailnet grant stops the request before Kubernetes.
2 · May the proxy impersonate this identity?
3 · May the effective identity perform this operation?
Network access and proxy impersonation rights do not grant resource permissions.
Recovery: tailscale-k0s uses an admin client certificate directly to a controller.
Preserve this separate context when configuring identity-based access.
